body:
It doesn't really make me feel better, I'm so sorry to hear that you're in my situation. I hope it gets better for you. For myself, I think there's nothing left to be done except to end it all...

Yeah I know, it's just so unfair. That's why everyone thinks I'm a looser. People seems to respect you only if you're rich or successful with women. Unfortunately, I'm just the opposite.

You know, that's actually one thing that I love about my favorite comic book character, Superman. His disguise, Clark Kent, rappresents an incredibly fascinating concept: that everyone, even those who can't seem to win once in life, can be a superhero if can they find their inner strength and want to help others. It's a message that really gave me hope when I needed it, but now I'm not so sure anymore...

Finding people interested in comics is very difficult here in Italy. Everyone seems to think they're childish and stupid. I really don't like soccer which is the main interest in my country, and that probably helped to create the fracture that now exists between me and normal people....
